name: skyhook-android
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for the SKYHOOK web game (AdMob interstitials + remove-ads non-consumable IAP). Reuses the web game as its source; the web version is untouched.

scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.add:android: npm run sync:web && cap add android
scripts.test: node src/test/ad-gate.test.mjs && node src/test/ads-consent.test.mjs && node src/test/monetisation.test.mjs && node scripts/listing-check.mjs
